pinkified.theme.strawberry_milk.desc: Milky pink panels, strawberry hearts and cream highlights.
pinkified.theme.lavender_dreams.desc: Soft lilac and purple with dreamy pink accents and macarons.
pinkified.theme.pink_coquette.desc: Baby pink and ivory tied with ribbon-red bows. Donuts included.
pinkified.theme.cherry_blossom.desc: Sakura pink and white with a hint of spring green and dango.
pinkified.theme.angelcore.desc: Cream, white and gold with sky-blue glimmers and cupcakes.
pinkified.theme.pastel_princess.desc: Pink-lilac royalty with golden sparkle and bonbons.
pinkified.theme.custom.desc: Build your own palette from any two colours.
pinkified.splash.5: Made with love by Sugarplum Studios!
pinkified.settings.title: Pinkified Settings
pinkified.option.themeWidgets.tooltip: Recolours buttons, sliders, checkboxes, list icons and the Minecraft logo, with softly rounded corners. Works in other mods' screens too.
pinkified.option.menuBackgrounds.tooltip: Replaces dirt backgrounds with an animated pastel sky and tints in-game menu backdrops.
pinkified.option.customMainMenu.tooltip: Use the animated Pinkified title screen. Turn off to keep the vanilla title screen (for example if another mod adds buttons to it).
pinkified.option.pauseMenuButton.tooltip: Adds a heart button next to Options that opens these settings.
pinkified.option.themeDeathScreen.toolti: A soft pastel game-over screen with drifting hearts instead of the red one.
pinkified.option.themeContainers.tooltip: Recolours the inventory, crafting table, furnaces, chests, anvil, enchanting table, creative menu and every other vanilla container.
pinkified.option.containerDecorations.to: Ties a little bow and heart onto container windows.
pinkified.option.themeTooltips.tooltip: Draws item tooltips in theme colours. Tooltips that other mods colour themselves are left alone.
pinkified.option.pinkGlint.tooltip: Enchanted items and armor shimmer in the theme colour.
pinkified.option.themeHearts.tooltip: Health hearts (including hardcore, absorption, poison, wither, freezing and mount hearts) and air bubbles in theme colours.
pinkified.option.foodStyle.tooltip: Which treat fills the hunger bar. Shift-click to go back.
pinkified.option.themeArmor.tooltip: Armor points become little heart shields.
pinkified.option.themeXpBar.tooltip: A sparkly gradient experience bar, a matching level number and horse jump bar.
pinkified.option.themeHotbar.tooltip: Pastel hotbar with a bow on the selected slot.
pinkified.option.themeEffectIcons.toolti: Softens status-effect icons and recolours their frames.
pinkified.option.crosshair.tooltip: Crosshair shape, drawn in theme colours. Shift-click to go back.
pinkified.option.particles.tooltip: Master switch for every cosmetic particle below. Only you can see them.
pinkified.option.ambientSparkles.tooltip: Little sparkles twinkle around you now and then.
pinkified.option.cherryBlossoms.tooltip: Petals drift down around you when you are outdoors.
pinkified.option.healHearts.tooltip: Hearts float up whenever you heal.
pinkified.option.flowerSteps.tooltip: Tiny flowers pop up as you walk on grass and dirt.
pinkified.option.levelUpSparkles.tooltip: A burst of sparkles and hearts when you gain a level.
pinkified.option.pinkEnchantParticles.to: The glyphs that fly into enchanting tables glow in theme colours.
pinkified.option.menuPetals.tooltip: Floating petals and sparkles in menu backgrounds.
pinkified.option.particleDensity.tooltip: How many cosmetic particles spawn. Your vanilla Particles setting is respected too.
pinkified.option.animations.tooltip: Animated buttons, logo, backgrounds and decorations.
pinkified.option.animationIntensity.tool: How lively and fast animations are.
pinkified.option.screenTransitions.toolt: Menus fade in gently when they open.
pinkified.option.menuMusic.tooltip: Plays an original music-box lullaby in menus instead of the vanilla menu music. Uses the Music volume.
pinkified.option.uiSounds.tooltip: Gentle chimes on Pinkified buttons and switches.
